newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK restaurant receipts rise 3 pct in 2nd qtr 96.
newsitem.headline: HK restaurant receipts rise 3 pct in 2nd qtr 96.

text.p: HONG KONG, Sept 26, Reuter - Total restaurant receipts increased three percent to HK$13 billion in the second quarter of 1996 from the same period last year, provisional Census and Statistics Department data showed.
Receipts of bars decreased by four percent, while those of Chinese restaurants decreased two percent.
Fast food outlets' receipts increased by 10 percent and those of non-Chinese restaurants grew by 12 percent.
In the first quarter of 1996 total restaurant receipts increased three percent year-on-year to HK$13.6 billion.
